The workbook generation failed because critical data cells in the 'Task' sheet were empty (None) instead of containing the expected calculated values.
The verifier reported multiple AssertionErrors in test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, cells in ranges H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned None instead of the expected float values (e.g., H12 expected 612.5, got None). This indicates a failure to correctly populate or calculate the matrix values in the 'Task' worksheet using the provided workbook() and task_sheet() functions.
